summary: The Bureau of Reclamation's Acting Commissioner indicated general concurrence with the adequacy of the draft ORV environmental statement. No substantive objections or suggested changes were noted, distinguishing this response from other bureaus that offered more detailed critiques. The Acting Commissioner's position is characterized as broadly supportive of the proposed action.
